correctness.rationale: The final theorem is exactly a finite-depth classification for odd n>1 under L_2(n)=product p^(a-1)(p-2). Unique factorization proves the complete inverse-prime-power algorithm: for L_2(n)=m every p-2 divides m and each exponent has p^(a-1)(p-2)|m. Every odd n>1 strictly decreases, yielding the exact disjoint recurrence B_(r+1)=L_2^(-1)(B_r), B_1={3}. Independently reimplemented inverse divisor/exponent enumeration with sympy factorization and exact primality, without using the package results as a lookup, and obtained rank sizes 1,3,13,54,226,986,4071,16693,67816,275129, total 364992, and respective maxima 3,15,105,735,5145,36015,252105,1764735,12353145,86472015. Each asserted maximum in ranks 2..10 equals 15*7^(r-2) and occurs once. The proof-plus-complete finite enumeration (not mere sampling) proves exactly these ten strata; it does NOT settle Defant Conjecture 20 beyond rank 10.

originality.rationale: Defant 2015 defines the iteration and states the global lower-bound inequality as Conjecture 20; a conjecture does not imply the finite census. Its finite plot of bounded inputs is logically weaker than complete rank fibers (which contain n up to 86,472,015). OEIS A241664 lists initial stopping values, not exhaustive inverse fibers and unique maxima for ranks 1..10. Resultary semantic search did not identify an exact rank-ten census. A plausible 2010 Harrington–Jones restricted-domain iteration is a named residual literature risk, not an automatic originality failure.

value.rationale: The ten finite stopping-rank fibers are mathematically natural strata of a published iteration problem; exact sizes and unique maxima without an input cutoff provide a reproducible finite-depth theorem and nontrivial first-ten verification of Defant’s named inequality. This does not purport to settle the infinite conjecture, and the arbitrary choice of depth 10 does not replace the intrinsic motivation from those first nontrivial rank fibers.
residual_risks: Only ten finite ranks; the bound beyond rank ten remains open.

scientific_limitations: Ranks 1 through 10 only, odd n>1; maximum witness formula and uniqueness established only for r<=10.
Exact finite enumeration is logically complete for these ranks but says nothing about higher ranks.
